summary: BLACK DRIFT HAVEN – SHARDS – NIGHT. A tumbling city of welded wrecks around an asteroid.
directionInline: A tumbling city of welded wrecks around an asteroid. Forgefires spit into vacuum. Plating gleams with oil-slick oxidation — purples, greens, bruised gold. A gantry over open space: VARRA CINDRAL walks in salvaged armor. A RIVAL CAPTAIN swaggers up, sneering. Varra doesn’t answer. Fast—she disarms him, a knee to the helm, and kicks him over the gantry. He slams into a netted salvage pit below, alive, humiliated. Varra turns to the watching crews. One quiet line: They erupt: fear, approval, relief. Engines around the rock spool up like answering throats.
Play the exchange as lived-in conversation: visible listening, interruptions and reaction beats; keep faces readable and let the environment remain active around them.
